moments.text: Infrared view: a bright V-shaped patch lower left under a dark band, crosshair at centre. A tiny bright dot sits left of and below the crosshair.
The screen flashes black then white; a flat grey view returns with a box around the crosshair. The tiny dot stays at the same spot.
The picture flashes white, black and grey several times as the view zooms in.
Zoomed view: a bright elongated dash crosses from the crosshair up and left, leaving the top edge. About 0.4 s: use frame step.
Mottled dark disc view; the dash is gone. A faint dot sits right of the crosshair.
Back to the wide grey view; the view drifts and shading changes, but the tiny dot stays fixed left of and below the crosshair.
A display change: smoother shading, a black box at top left, and the tiny dot now sits right of and above the crosshair.
The earlier display returns; the tiny dot is back left of and below the crosshair.
A small dark shape trailing a pale line enters at the upper right and drifts across to the left edge.
Narrow view: a dark dot with a faint grey smear sits at the upper right corner of the crosshair box.
After a flash, a zoomed view of rippled water: a dark blob trailing a pale wake below centre; a long dark rectangle slides in from the right.
Another zoomed water view: a small dark shape trailing a wake moves from the left edge toward the crosshair.
The picture turns flat purple-grey with no image as the clip ends.

notes: Grey side panels not cropped (crop null). The tiny dot stays at a fixed screen position across pans for most of the clip.
